text: 美股三大指数集体高开，标普500指数涨0.31%，道指涨0.36%，纳指涨0.15%。大型科技股方面，谷歌A涨1.34%，苹果涨1.20%，超威半导体跌3.35%。中概股方面，小鹏集团跌1.27%，哔哩哔哩跌1.48%，理想汽车跌1.63%，蔚来跌1.64%。
text_en: The three major US stock indexes opened higher collectively, with the S&P 500 up 0.31%, the Dow up 0.36%, and the Nasdaq up 0.15%. Among large technology stocks, Alphabet Class A rose 1.34%, Apple rose 1.20%, and Advanced Micro Devices fell 3.35%. Among Chinese concept stocks, XPeng fell 1.27%, Bilibili fell 1.48%, Li Auto fell 1.63%, and NIO fell 1.64%.
